description: This file defines a PHP class 'SubTotal' within the Opencart namespace, which extends an engine model and calculates subtotal totals for an e-commerce cart.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: Class responsible for calculating the subtotal of items in the cart and adding this total to the list of totals in the system.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the cart subtotal, optionally adds voucher amounts, and appends the subtotal information to the totals array while updating the total sum.
